title: Pure Bystial
summary: The Bystial Dragon engine paired with the three Branded Continuous Spell/Traps that mention Bystial, Rank 6 Xyz bosses, Bystial Dis Pater, and Albaz Fusion targets; the full Fallen of Albaz Fusion line has its own Branded decklist. Every Level 6 Bystial banishes a LIGHT or DARK monster from either GY to Special Summon itself from the hand—as a Quick Effect once the opponent controls a monster.

summary.title: Starters & Handtrap Dragons
points: The Bystial Lubellion discards itself from the hand to search any Bystial monster from the Deck, Special Summons itself from the hand or GY by Tributing a Level 6 or higher DARK Dragon, and places a Branded Continuous Spell/Trap face-up from the Deck.
Bystial Magnamhut (Limited) banishes a LIGHT or DARK monster from either GY to summon itself and searches any Dragon from the Deck or GY during the End Phase.
Bystial Saronir banishes a LIGHT or DARK monster to summon itself and sends a Bystial monster or Branded Spell/Trap from the Deck to the GY whenever it is sent to the GY.

Bystial Druiswurm (Limited) sends an opposing Special Summoned monster to the GY when sent from the field to the GY, and Bystial Baldrake Tributes another LIGHT or DARK monster on the field to banish an opposing Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster.

summary.title: Opening: The Bystial Lubellion
steps: Discard The Bystial Lubellion from the hand to search Bystial Saronir (or Bystial Magnamhut).

Banish The Bystial Lubellion from your GY to Special Summon Bystial Saronir from the hand, then Tribute Saronir to Special Summon The Bystial Lubellion from the GY; Saronir triggers in the GY to send Branded Regained or another Bystial to the GY.
Use Lubellion's field effect to place Branded Beast face-up from the Deck; in the End Phase, Branded Beast places Branded Regained face-up from the GY.

summary.title: The Bystial Aluber & Bystial Dis Pater
summary.text: The Bystial Aluber is a Level 4 DARK Dragon Tuner whose name becomes Fallen of Albaz on the field or in the GY. When Normal or Special Summoned, it discards 1 card and targets a Dragon the opponent controls or in their GY to either send itself to the GY and take control of that field Dragon or Special Summon that GY Dragon to your field. Tuning the Level 4 Aluber with any Level 6 Bystial brings out the Level 10 Synchro Bystial Dis Pater, which revives a banished LIGHT or DARK monster and shuffles a banished card into the Deck to destroy or negate an opposing monster.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Bystial Dis Pater revives a banished LIGHT or DARK monster each turn (fueling its own Quick Effect) and returns a banished card to the Deck to negate a monster effect (if returning your banished card) or destroy a monster (if returning the opponent's).

The Bystial Alba Los Special Summons itself by Tributing 2 Bystials, negates the effects of all face-up Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters on the field, and banishes all face-down Extra Deck cards until the opponent's End Phase if it leaves the field by their effect.
Number 24: Dragulas the Vampiric Dragon, Wollow, Founder of the Drudge Dragons, Gauntlet Launcher, and Pilgrim Reaper provide Rank 6 Xyz utility from any two Level 6 Bystials.
Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon and Rindbrumm the Striking Dragon sit in the Extra Deck as Fallen of Albaz Fusion bosses.

summary.title: Branded Continuous Backrow
points: Branded Regained shuffles a banished LIGHT or DARK monster into the bottom of the Deck to draw 1 card once per turn, and revives a Bystial from your GY whenever the opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.

Branded Beast Tributes 1 Dragon during either Main Phase while you control a Bystial to destroy 1 card the opponent controls, and places a Branded Continuous Spell/Trap from your GY face-up on the field during the End Phase.
Branded Befallen prevents the opponent from targeting your Bystials with activated effects and negates any card or effect activated in response to your Bystials.

allow.Branded Beast: Needs a Bystial monster; The Bystial Lubellion places it from the Deck.
allow.Branded Befallen: Protects Bystial monsters; The Bystial Lubellion places it from the Deck.
allow.Branded Regained: Revives Bystial monsters; The Bystial Lubellion places it from the Deck.
allow.Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon: Pinnacle Albaz Fusion boss that non-target banishes monsters and board-wipes if removed by the opponent.
allow.Rindbrumm the Striking Dragon: Level 8 Fusion disruption that negates Extra Deck monster effects and bounces cards.
